WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) as num_films
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY actor_id
    ORDER BY num_films DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
actor_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fa.film_id
    FROM film_actor fa
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_5_actors)
),
film_inventory AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.inventory_id
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN actor_films af ON i.film_id = af.film_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN film_inventory fi ON r.inventory_id = fi.inventory_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_rentals) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) as percentage
